{{Quote|Before you even ask, the prototype was stolen. You will have to recover it from the thieves before they can fence it. They let slip that their hideout is somewhere outside of Narmle.|Seldair Keeloo|<ref name="SWG:DIT" />}}
The '''Thieves Bunker''' was a hideout used by [[Thief/Legends|techno-thieves]] near the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Narmle (city)|Narmle]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] [[Swamp/Legends|swamp]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Rori/Legends|Rori]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], [[Seldair Keeloo]] tasked an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] operative with [[Death/Legends|killing]] several of the thieves to recover a prototype [[Missile/Legends|rocket]] important to [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]].<ref name="SWG:DIT" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Thieves Bunker was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:DIT" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Rebel Base was added to the game with the revamped "[[W:c:swg:Imperial Theme Park|Imperial Theme Park]],"<ref name="SWG:DIT" /> released with the "[[W:c:swg:Update Notes 6.12: September 13 2007|Chapter 6.12]]" update, on [[September 13]], [[2007]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 6.12: Masters of the Wild">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67417&month=092007|text=Chapter 6.12: Masters of the Wild}}</ref>
